chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ismail ibn Marrar, from Yunus, from a man, from Sa'd al-Askaf, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said:
Indeed, in salt is a cure for seventy illnesses, or he said: seventy types of pains. Then he said: If the people knew what is in the salt, they would not cure (themselves) except by it.
ai.seo_question: What are the medicinal benefits of salt according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In this hadith from al-Kafi, Imam Muhammad al-Baqir (peace be upon him) highlights the profound medicinal value of salt, asserting it cures seventy distinct ailments. He underscores its universal efficacy by suggesting that if humanity fully comprehended its healing power, it would become the primary remedy for all diseases, reflecting the Shia tradition of recognizing practical wisdom in everyday substances.
